descriptionHtml:
A premium leather pouch, approx. 14.5 × 24.5 cm, that keeps your valuables safe by unlocking with your fingerprint only. The coolest, most necessary safe on the go.

  • Save up to 10 fingerprints
  • One charge lasts about 800 to 1,000 unlocks
  • Charging cable and emergency key included
  • Available in 7 colors: black, etoupe, grey, beige, blush pink, orangey camel and dark green

Free delivery in Lebanon.

seo.title: smART fingerprint leather pouch | Elle.ay
seo.description: The smART leather pouch opens with your fingerprint only. Up to 10 fingerprints, cable and emergency key included. 7 colors, free delivery in Lebanon.
